name: Nova Entertainments x Band Infusion Live in Charlotte, NC
description:
NOVA Entertainments presents Band Infusion

**Saturday, October 10 · Concord Event Center · Concord / Charlotte, NC**

**8:30 PM – 12 AM: Band Infusion (Live)
12 AM – 2 AM: DJ Rinku (After Party)**

**Band Infusion is playing Concord on October 10.** Live band, full room, food and drinks, and a Saturday that doesn't need a lot of dressing up in words. 🎶

If you've seen them before, you know how the night goes: the set builds, people stop hovering at the edges, and the floor fills. If you haven't, this is a straightforward live show — not a playlist, not a DJ set with a live sticker on it. A band on stage.

**Concord Event Center sits just north of Charlotte on Concord Parkway.** Easy to get to, room to move, bars in the building. Come with friends, come with family, stay as late as the night holds. 🍻

Tickets first. October 10 is one date, and it won't sit open forever. 🎟️
